claims.statement: Hold about one scoring joker per ante: 1 by the end of ante 1, 2 by the end of ante 2, 3 in ante 3, 4 in ante 4, 5 (every slot scoring) by ante 5. The other slots hold money/value jokers: 2 at ante 3, 1 at ante 4, 0 at ante 5. A strong joker counts as more than one (Half Joker or a Polychrome Even Steven about 1.5), a Planet level about 0.5; small buffs (+4 Mult flat, x1.2) count as nothing. Below the curve, a scoring joker beats a value joker; at or above it, bank or buy value.
